observed.note: admission precedes native qualification; admitted yield is an UPPER bound on the mined-to-qualified yield

assumptions: the pilot admission yield applies to newly mined repositories
API calls scale linearly with candidates at the pilot ratio
no native-qualification losses (all totals are before them)

repository_minimum.policy_source: docs/REPOSITORY_NATIVE_EVALUATION_PROTOCOL.md (D3: at least 34 repositories, at most 12 targets per repository)

projection.statement: About 8,400 mined candidates per 350 admitted functions at the point estimate (range 3,732-19,554); about 16,800 for a 350-function gate plus a similar Phase 6 cohort. About 89.8 unauthenticated API hours per cohort and 179.7 for both, before native-qualification losses. Two repository-disjoint cohorts need at least 68 distinct repositories.

multiplicity_3a.correction: the design names the family only as 'the primary H4 and H1 contrasts' and does not enumerate them; the six contrasts were chosen when v3 was written, after the results were known. The Holm calculation is preserved numerically, but it is not a fully predeclared family and supports NO familywise confirmatory claim
multiplicity_3a.decisions_unchanged: H1 (open) and H4 (open, schema-dependent) are decided by the frozen interval and route rules, not by these p-values; both decisions are unchanged

observed.design_text_verbatim: Holm across the primary H4 and H1 contrasts

power_evidence_status.consequence: group counts in the power receipt are planning ranges for the synthetic distribution; they are not guaranteed repository sample sizes, and real power is expected to be lower
simulation_assumptions: decisions use cluster-sandwich normal intervals, not the exact paired cluster-bootstrap gate
injected effects are shared across the two answer schemas by construction and do not span every possible cross-schema treatment-effect dependence
outcomes are synthetic train-side MBPP/HumanEval Phase 3A outcomes, not repository-native outcomes
the answer-rate, validity and diversity guardrails are not modelled
power_evidence_status.status: PLANNING EVIDENCE, NOT A POWER GUARANTEE
